description: This file contains functions related to validation, evaluation, and metrics calculation for an object detection model, specifically using YOLO architecture. It includes utility functions for bounding box conversion, batch processing, and a main run function for validation inference.

methods.name: xywh2xyxy(box_coord : torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Converts bounding box coordinates from center_x, center_y, width, height to corner coordinates x1, y1, x2, y2.

methods.name: process_batch(detections, labels, iouv)
methods.description: Processes a batch of detections and labels to determine correct predictions at multiple IoU thresholds.

methods.name: run(model, val_dataloader, num_class, net_dim=416, nms_thresh=0.6, objectness_thresh=0.001, device="cpu")
methods.description: Main validation loop that runs inference on the validation dataset, calculates metrics such as mAP, and evaluates model performance.

ctags.name: run
ctags.pattern: /^def run(model, val_dataloader, num_class, net_dim=416, nms_thresh=0.6, objectness_thresh=0.001, /
ctags.signature: (model, val_dataloader, num_class, net_dim=416, nms_thresh=0.6, objectness_thresh=0.001, device="cpu")
